items.name: vv
items.title: vv design system index
items.description: Every item in the vv registry, its tier and when to use it.
items.docs: Start here. Read the items this index names with `npx shadcn view ./registry/r/<item>.json` from web/.

items.name: vv-theme
items.title: vv theme tokens
items.description: Every design-system token (colour roles, type, spacing and sizes, radius, shadow, motion) in web/src/ui/tokens.css.
items.docs: Use only the utility classes these tokens generate. Which role each colour plays and which step to use where: web/registry/rules/foundations.md (item vv-rules).

items.name: vv-rules
items.title: vv design-system rules
items.description: The usage rules of the vv design system, one file per tier.
items.docs: Read foundations.md before choosing a colour, a type step, a spacing step, a radius or a shadow, and components.md before choosing, composing or adding a component.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A message inside a section: error, warning, done or guidance, with an icon, a title and a description.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: AlertDialog
items.description: Confirms an action that cannot be undone, with Cancel and an action named by its verb. Uses button.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A small label: tag chip, count or status.

items.name: brand-home-link
items.title: BrandHomeLink
items.description: vv component: the VVMDM logo in the top bar, linking to the library.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: The path to the current folder.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Actions: one default (primary) per area, then secondary, outline, ghost, destructive and link, in sizes sm, default, lg, icon-sm and icon.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Turns one option on or off in a form or a selection; has an indeterminate state.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Picks one value from many by typing to narrow them: a Command in a popover. Uses button and command.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: A list narrowed by what is typed, chosen with the keyboard; the inside of a combobox.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal window for a form or a long choice, with a title, a body and a footer. Uses button.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: DropdownMenu
items.description: A list of actions or one choice from a few, opened from a button.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: The empty state of a list or section: icon, reason and the action that fills it.

items.name: favorite-toggle
items.title: FavoriteToggle
items.description: vv component: the favorite heart, mark and toggle in one, for cards, rows and the video page. Uses toggle and tooltip.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: One form field: label, control, description and error. Uses label.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A one-line text field.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A key or search operator in text or a tooltip.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: The visible name of a control; pressing it focuses the control.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A non-modal panel anchored to its trigger, for a few options or a short form.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: How far a known amount of work has come; indeterminate without a value.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: RadioGroup
items.description: Picks one value from a few options that stay visible.

items.name: scrub-preview
items.title: ScrubPreview
items.description: vv component: the card scrub band and frame inside a VideoThumbnail.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Picks one value from a fixed list in a dropdown.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A hairline between groups of controls or sections.

items.name: sheet
items.title: Sheet
items.description: A panel from the screen's edge; in vv only the sidebar's narrow-width drawer. Uses button.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: The app's main navigation: expanded, icon rail and narrow-width drawer. Uses button, input, separator, sheet, skeleton and tooltip.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: The final layout's shapes while content loads.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Picks a value on a stepped or continuous range, such as the card size.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Sonner
items.description: The Toaster for short, passive notices sent with toast() from sonner.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: A short wait with no measure.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Turns a setting on or off with immediate effect.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switches between views of the same content in place.

items.name: tentative-mark
items.title: TentativeMark
items.description: vv component: the dashed circle after a tentative tag's name.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line text field that grows with its content.

items.name: thumbnail-backdrop
items.title: ThumbnailBackdrop
items.description: vv component: a blurred copy behind a portrait thumbnail.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: A button that stays pressed, such as an applied filter.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: ToggleGroup
items.description: A row of toggles, exclusive (view mode, sort direction) or independent. Uses toggle.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Names an icon-only control or adds a short hint on hover and focus.

items.name: video-thumbnail
items.title: VideoThumbnail
items.description: vv component: the 16:9 thumbnail frame with duration, progress edge, corner marks and a notice. Uses progress.
